item.grappin.grappin.aide1: Right click: fire the hook (30 blocks); it only holds on an anchor point
item.grappin.grappin.aide2: Hooked: hold right click to be pulled in; release it to stay hooked and swing; scroll wheel = rope length
item.grappin.grappin.aide3: Jump or sneak: let go of the hook with a jump
item.grappin.voile.aide2: %s s of air underwater, recharged in %s s at the surface
item.grappin.voile.aide3: Worn, while the reserve lasts: night vision and fast swimming
item.grappin.paravoile.aide1: In your hand (main or off hand): jump in mid-air to open the glider and glide
item.grappin.paravoile.aide2: Your view steers: look down to dive, look up to brake; jump or sneak to stow it
item.grappin.paravoile.aide3: %s s of flight, gauge recharged in %s s on the ground
entity.grappin.golem.phase2: The Root Guardian unleashes its fury!
